name: AutoVectorizeV2
scope: The hfusion-auto-vectorize-v2 pass and its AutoVectorize/ planning helpers (PlanContext, FusedNode, FusionUtils, Verify): candidate classification, group formation, conflict model, tile-size policy, transform-sequence emission, and the clone-attempt discipline. Includes the immediately-following OutlineVectorFunctionPass because it materializes the VF functions this pass labels, and the regbase pipeline placement. Excludes the cost-model internals of TreeReduceV2, the HFusionToVector conversion, and MergeVecScope's merge mechanics.

related_entities.name: VFFusionPass (analysis::createVFFusionPass)
related_entities.relation: upstream on the Triton-kernel path: outlines work into private _fused_ functions and freezes tree-reduce selection attrs that AutoVectorizeV2 consumes and finally strips

related_entities.name: OutlineVectorFunctionPass (outline-vector-function)
related_entities.relation: runs immediately after; outlines the loops AutoVectorizeV2 labeled outlined-loop-target-* into hivm.vector_function callees

related_entities.name: MergeVecScope (hfusion-merge-vf)
related_entities.relation: downstream consumer in the HIVM regbase bufferization pipeline; merges the VF functions/scopes produced by outlining

related_entities.name: AutoVectorize (hfusion-auto-vectorize, V1)
related_entities.relation: legacy alternative branch of the same pipeline stage, selected when enableAutoVectorizeV2 is false

related_entities.name: AutoVectorizeVerifier (hfusion-auto-vectorize-verifier)
related_entities.relation: separate pass after both branches; also used in-function by AutoVectorizeV2 via hfusion::AutoVectorizeVerifier

related_entities.name: TreeReduceV2 (tree-reduce-v2)
related_entities.relation: conditional follow-up that rewrites loops AutoVectorizeV2 marked kRegisterTreeReductionLoopAttr

related_entities.name: PlanContext / FusedNode / VFStackInfoBuilder
related_entities.relation: owned planning data structures for grouping, conflicts, and stack-slot budget

why_this_subject: Phase T3 dogfood of the multi-pass system story: AutoVectorizeV2 is the pass that turns scalar/tensor-level linalg groups into outlined vector functions, so it is the producer side of the MergeVecScope consumer already analyzed (2026-09-08-mergevecscope-pass). It is a large transform pass (1672-line entry file plus a planning directory) whose VF labels and hivm.vector_function callees are cross-component contracts, and its behavior only makes sense as a pipeline position (VFFusion before, outlining/merging/bufferization after).
